root_cause: The color contrast for the selected day button (data-pika-day="23") fails WCAG 1.4.3 because the selected state uses white text (#fff) on a blue background (#33aaff) with a contrast ratio of only ~2.9:1. The default button state (#666 on #f5f5f5) also fails at ~2.25:1. The automated rule flagged the selected button for day 23.
repair_strategy: Darken the background colors for selected, range, and default button states to achieve at least 4.5:1 contrast with white text, and darken the default button text color for non-overridden states.
expected_accessibility_effect: Selected day buttons, range buttons, and default day buttons now meet WCAG 1.4.3 contrast requirements (>=4.5:1) for text against background, improving readability for users with low vision.
functional_risks: Color changes are visual only; no functional behavior is altered.
The new dark blue (#002244) and dark green (#003300) may appear different from the original theme but maintain the same semantic meaning.
verification_requirements: Automated color-contrast rule should no longer flag button[data-pika-day="23"] in selected state.
Default day buttons (non-selected, non-today, non-disabled) should pass contrast with #222 on #f5f5f5.
Start-range and end-range buttons should pass contrast with white text on their new backgrounds.
